restrictedWithSecurityFilter.note: Security filter on Customer (No.=10000) reduced List_Customers_PAG30009 to 1 of 7 rows in both static and dynamic mode; records outside the filter are absent, not refused. The filter does not cascade: sales orders, quotes and invoices of other customers stay visible until Sales Header (and posted document tables) get their own filter. The filter took effect within minutes of saving the permission set, without a new sign-in.
